pages.text: 晚上，咘咘躺在床上准备睡觉。Sam爸爸神秘地走过来，眨眨眼睛说：「咘咘，明天爸爸妈妈要带你去一个特别的地方！」
pages.text_en: At bedtime, Bubu was lying in bed. Sam Daddy walked over with a mysterious smile and whispered, 'Bubu, tomorrow Mommy and Daddy are taking you somewhere very special!'

pages.text: 咘咘一下子坐起来：「是游乐场吗？」爸爸摇摇头。「是动物园？」爸爸又摇摇头，笑着给了一个线索：「那里有星星、月亮，还有火星！」
pages.text_en: Bubu sat up excitedly. 'Is it the playground?' Daddy shook his head. 'The zoo?' Daddy shook his head again and gave a hint: 'There are stars, the moon, and even Mars!'

pages.text: 第二天一早，全家人来到了上海天文馆。哇！巨大的银色建筑像天体运行的轨道一样弯弯曲曲，又像一个超级大飞碟！咘咘张大嘴巴：「好酷啊！」
pages.text_en: The next morning, the whole family arrived at the Shanghai Astronomy Museum. Wow! The enormous silver building curved like an orbital path, looking like a giant flying saucer! Bubu's mouth dropped open: 'So cool!'

pages.text: 走进「家园」展区，一个巨大的太阳系模型悬浮在头顶。木星好大好大！Coco指着它说：「Look, Bubu! That's Jupiter! It's the biggest planet!」咘咘仰着头，数着一颗一颗行星。
pages.text_en: Inside the 'Home' exhibition hall, a massive solar system model floated overhead. Jupiter was enormous! Coco pointed and said, 'Look, Bubu! That\'s Jupiter! It\'s the biggest planet!' Bubu looked up, counting the planets one by one.

pages.text: 大厅中央有一个巨大的傅科摆，金色的摆锤在慢慢、慢慢地晃动。NOMI蹲下来轻声说：「咘咘你看，这个大摆锤能证明地球在转动呢！」咘咘瞪大眼睛：「地球在转？我怎么没感觉到？」
pages.text_en: In the center of the hall hung a giant Foucault pendulum. The golden pendulum swung slowly, slowly. NOMI knelt down and whispered, 'Look Bubu, this big pendulum proves the Earth is spinning!' Bubu's eyes went wide: 'The Earth is spinning? But I can't feel it!'

pages.text: 来到「宇宙」展区，一个巨大的屏幕上模拟着黑洞。所有的光都被吸进去了！NONO站在咘咘肩膀上，小声说：「好可怕……光都跑不掉！」Tina妈妈抱着咘咘说：「别怕，这只是模拟的呀。」
pages.text_en: In the 'Universe' exhibition, a huge screen simulated a black hole. All the light was being sucked in! NONO perched on Bubu's shoulder and whispered, 'So scary... even light can\'t escape!' Tina Mommy hugged Bubu: 'Don\'t worry, it\'s just a simulation.'

pages.text: 最激动人心的来了——「航向火星」！大家坐上了模拟飞船，咘咘坐在指挥官的位置上。Coco喊：「Captain Bubu, ready for launch!」咘咘举起小手：「三、二、一，出发！」飞船轰隆隆震动起来！
pages.text_en: The most exciting part arrived — 'Voyage to Mars'! Everyone boarded the simulated spacecraft, and Bubu sat in the commander's seat. Coco called out: 'Captain Bubu, ready for launch!' Bubu raised her little paw: 'Three, two, one, blast off!' The ship rumbled and shook!

pages.text: 飞船「降落」在火星表面！窗外是红色的岩石和沙漠。咘咘兴奋地说：「我们到火星了！」Sam爸爸笑着说：「指挥官辛苦了，任务完成！」全家人都为咘咘鼓掌。
pages.text_en: The spacecraft 'landed' on the surface of Mars! Outside the window were red rocks and desert. Bubu exclaimed excitedly, 'We made it to Mars!' Sam Daddy laughed: 'Great job, Commander! Mission complete!' Everyone clapped for Bubu.

pages.text: 接下来是「好奇星球」儿童区。这里有巨大的花朵、奇奇怪怪的植物、还有冰火山！就像来到了外星世界。咘咘和Coco在巨大的花丛里钻来钻去，NONO在花瓣上跳来跳去。
pages.text_en: Next was the 'Curious Planet' children's zone. There were giant flowers, bizarre plants, and ice volcanoes! It was like an alien world. Bubu and Coco darted through the enormous blooms while NONO hopped from petal to petal.

pages.text: 球幕影院里，大家躺在椅子上看星空电影。满天的星星在头顶旋转，银河像一条闪闪发光的河流。咘咘伸出小手想去摸星星：「好近啊，好像伸手就能碰到！」
pages.text_en: In the dome theater, everyone lay back in their seats watching a space film. Stars swirled overhead and the Milky Way flowed like a glittering river. Bubu reached up her little paw: 'They're so close! I feel like I can touch them!'

pages.text: 看完电影，大家去2楼餐厅吃星球冰淇淋！咘咘的是土星形状的，有一圈彩色的「星环」。Coco的是蓝色的地球。咘咘舔了一口：「星星的味道是草莓的！」
pages.text_en: After the film, everyone went to the second-floor café for planet ice cream! Bubu's was shaped like Saturn with a colorful ring. Coco's was a blue Earth. Bubu took a lick: 'Stars taste like strawberry!'

pages.text: 回家的路上，咘咘趴在车窗上看着夜空中的月亮，轻轻说：「月亮，我今天看到你的家了，好漂亮……」然后突然想起来——这是爸爸昨晚讲的故事！明天才是真的去天文馆！咘咘抱着小枕头，兴奋得翻来翻去：「快点天亮吧！」
pages.text_en: On the way home, Bubu pressed against the car window gazing at the moon: 'Moon, I saw your home today, it was so beautiful...' Then she suddenly remembered — this was Daddy's bedtime story! Tomorrow is the real trip! Bubu hugged her pillow, too excited to sleep: 'Hurry up, morning!'
